messages:
jess_cs: Heads-up: NebulaPay (acct NP-44) onboarding smoke test failing. Mobile RN app sees a flurry of preflight 429s on coldstart, GA planned Friday. Can we triage quickly?

sam_eng: Do we have how many parallel inits and which SDK version? Also are these preflight or token exchange failures?

jess_cs: They said ~8-15 parallel preflight attempts from coldstart across threads. SDK is mobile-js v0.9.2 (RN bundle). Logs show 429s with header X-Client-Timestamp sometimes 10-25s behind server. Sample: 
```
[2026-03-22T20:11:07Z] GET /v1/preflight 429 X-RateLimit-Remaining:0 window=60
meta: client=mobile-js/0.9.2 rn:prod region=us-east-1 X-Client-Timestamp=2026-03-22T20:10:49Z
```

infra_support: Two likely contributors: clock skew on devices causing TTL mismatch + lack of preflight coalescing in the RN bridge leading to parallel token requests.

enablement: Customer note: the 429 surface looked identical to our 401 sample in their quickstart, confused their devs. They asked for clearer messaging and a short checklist to debug.

sam_eng: Quick mitigation steps for them:
- Upgrade SDK to 0.9.3 which includes server-time fallback when X-Client-Timestamp delta > 5s.
- Add client-side coalescing on app startup: single inflight preflight promise shared across modules.
- Add jittered backoff for preflight failures. Example snippet we can share: 
```js
// naive shared preflight
let preflightPromise = null
function getPreflight() {
  if (preflightPromise) return preflightPromise
  preflightPromise = fetch('/v1/preflight').then(r => r.json()).finally(() => { preflightPromise = null })
  return preflightPromise
}
// jittered backoff
const backoff = (i) => Math.min(800 * 2**i + Math.random()*250, 8000)
```

ops: We can also flip NP-44 into temporary onboarding-mode: increase their preflight window 3x and enable edge-key coalescing for 72h. Need explicit OK from CS. Will monitor error rates and cpu on edge layer.

jess_cs: Please do, ops. I told customer we need the SDK patch out ASAP but their release pipelines will take a day. Onboarding-mode will buy time.

ops: Done. NP-44 set to onboarding-mode until 2026-03-25T04:00:00Z, preflight quota x3, edge coalescing enabled. Watching 1m/5m error trends.

sam_eng: I'll open an internal docs ticket and a small quickstart edit: call it "preflight: mobile gotchas" — include clock skew, shared preflight promise pattern, and backoff. Link to CS-1301 for renewal notes.

doc-bot: Ticket CS-1301 created: "quickstart: preflight mobile gotchas + shared promise snippet" assigned to sam_eng/docs.

enablement: Action items recap:
- ops: onboarding-mode (done).
- jess_cs: coordinate customer patch and confirm when they roll v0.9.3.
- sam_eng: quickstart edit + sample code + mention response headers to inspect (X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-Server-Time).
- infra_support: follow up whether we can surface clearer 429 variants for auth vs rate-limit to reduce confusion.

jess_cs: Also logging customer sentiment: if we don't get GA green by Friday their renewal score likely shifts negative. Adding this to account health notes.

sam_eng: Noted. Will prioritize the quickstart blurb.

jess_cs: Thanks all, I'll update NebulaPay once their next canary finishes. :rocket:
